faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about planning your Gokusafiri journey  from booking to departure and beyond.
faq.sidebar_desc: Our team of Africa specialists is available Mon–Sat, 8am–8pm EAT. We reply to emails within 2 hours.
faq.cta_subtitle: Browse our hand-crafted safaris or talk to an expert  we'll make the planning effortless.
faq.q1: How do I start planning my safari?
faq.a1: Browse our tours and packages to find a journey that appeals to you, then click "Reserve" to secure your spot with a 20% deposit. Alternatively, contact our team at hello@gokusafiri.com and we'll design something bespoke for you.
faq.q2: What is the best time to visit Africa?
faq.a2: It depends on the destination and experience. The Great Migration in the Maasai Mara peaks between July and October. Gorilla trekking in Uganda is best during the dry seasons (June–August and December–February). Coastal destinations like Zanzibar are wonderful year-round. Our team can advise on the best season for your chosen itinerary.
faq.q3: Are your safaris suitable for families with children?
faq.a3: Yes  many of our tours are family-friendly, with child-appropriate activities and lodges that welcome families. Most parks have a minimum age of 7 for game drives, and 15 for gorilla treks. Contact us to find the best family options for your children's ages.
faq.a4: Most African destinations require or recommend vaccinations for Yellow Fever, Typhoid, and Hepatitis A. A malaria prophylaxis is recommended for most safari destinations. We recommend consulting a travel health clinic or your GP at least 6 weeks before travel.
faq.q5: What is included in the tour price?
faq.a5: Each tour description lists exactly what is included and excluded. Generally, our safari prices include accommodation, park fees, guiding, and meals as specified. International flights, visas, travel insurance, and personal expenses are typically not included.
faq.a6: Absolutely. Every Gokusafiri itinerary can be tailored to your travel style, budget, and special interests. Contact us with your vision and our specialists will design a bespoke safari within 48 hours.
faq.q7: Is it safe to travel to Africa?
faq.a7: Africa is a vast and diverse continent. The destinations we operate in have strong safety records for travelers. We continuously monitor travel advisories and will never operate in areas that pose a genuine risk to our guests. Your safety is our first priority.
faq.q8: How small are your group sizes?
faq.a8: Most of our standard departures cap at 12 participants. Many of our premium tours are available as private departures for 2–6 guests. Smaller groups mean more flexible game drives, better wildlife sightings, and a more personal experience.
faq.a9: USD is the most widely accepted currency for tips and small purchases in most African safari destinations. Local currencies are useful in towns and markets. Your tour guide will advise on specific currency needs for your destination.
faq.q10: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a10: We recommend booking 3–6 months in advance for peak-season travel (July–October and December–January). Gorilla trekking permits in particular sell out months ahead. Last-minute bookings are sometimes possible for off-peak departures.
about.title: Born from the wild, built for you
about.subtitle: Gokusafiri began with a simple belief  Africa's wild places deserve better storytelling, and travelers deserve deeper connections.
about.story_title: A decade of wild places. One platform.
about.story_p1: In 2018, a small group of East African guides and hospitality veterans gathered around a campfire in the Maasai Mara with one question: why was booking a world-class African safari still so complicated, opaque, and impersonal?
about.story_p2: Gokusafiri was their answer. We built a platform that combines the intimacy of a boutique travel agency with the transparency of modern technology  so you spend less time on logistics and more time watching the sunrise over the Serengeti.
about.story_p3: Today we operate across 14 African countries, partner with over 200 conservation-certified lodges, and have helped more than 120,000 travelers discover Africa on their own terms.
about.val1_body: Every journey is designed and guided by people who call Africa home  local voices who know the land, the wildlife, and the culture.
about.val2_body: We partner exclusively with conservation-certified lodges and contribute to wildlife sanctuaries in every destination we operate.
about.val3_body: Fully bonded payments, 24/7 on-trip emergency support, and free cancellation on most bookings  so you travel with complete peace of mind.
about.val4_body: No two Gokusafiri journeys are alike. We tailor every itinerary around your pace, your interests, and your travel style.
about.team1_bio: Born in Dakar and raised between Nairobi and Cape Town, Amara spent a decade leading wilderness safaris before co-founding Gokusafiri.
about.team2_bio: A certified master guide with 18 years in the Maasai Mara, James personally vets every guide and lodge partner in our network.
about.team3_bio: Lena has built partnerships with 30+ conservation NGOs across Africa, ensuring every tour generates a measurable positive impact.
about.team4_bio: A former tech lead from Paris, Marc built the digital infrastructure that makes booking your dream safari as simple as a few clicks.

help.title: How can we help?
help.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions below, or get in touch with our team directly.
help.cat1_q1: How do I book a safari?
help.cat1_a1: Browse our tours and packages, pick your preferred trip, and click "Reserve". You can secure your spot with a 20% deposit  the balance is only due 30 days before departure. We'll send a full confirmation within 2 hours.
help.cat1_q2: Can I book for a group?
help.cat1_a2: Yes. You can add multiple travelers during the checkout flow. For groups of 8 or more, contact us directly at hello@gokusafiri.com  we offer custom group pricing and can arrange dedicated group departures.
help.cat1_q3: How far in advance should I book?
help.cat1_a3: We recommend booking 3–6 months ahead for popular departures (especially during peak season: July–October and December–January). Some tours have limited slots, so early booking is advisable.
help.cat1_q4: Can I request a custom itinerary?
help.cat1_a4: Absolutely. Contact our team at hello@gokusafiri.com or via WhatsApp and we'll design a tailored itinerary around your dates, budget, and travel style. Most bespoke proposals are ready within 48 hours.
help.cat2_a1: All prices are displayed in USD. We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) via our secure Stripe checkout. Currency conversion is handled at your bank's rate.
help.cat2_a2: Yes. Payments are processed by Stripe and secured with 256-bit SSL encryption. Gokusafiri never stores your card details. We are also fully bonded, meaning your money is protected even in unlikely business disruptions.
help.cat2_a3: If you pay a 20% deposit at booking, the remaining balance is due 30 days before your departure date. You'll receive automatic reminders and a secure payment link by email.
help.cat2_a4: No. The price shown on each tour includes all listed services, park fees, and taxes. Optional add-ons (such as visa assistance or travel insurance) are itemised separately before you confirm.
help.cat3_a1: Cancellations 90+ days before departure receive a full refund. The refund decreases on a sliding scale closer to the departure date  see our full Cancellation Policy page for details.
help.cat3_q2: Can I change my travel dates?
help.cat3_a2: Yes, date changes are possible subject to availability. Changes requested more than 60 days before departure are free of charge. A $50 administration fee applies within 60 days. Contact us as early as possible.
help.cat3_q3: What if Gokusafiri cancels my tour?
help.cat3_a3: In the unlikely event we cancel a tour (e.g., due to safety concerns or natural events), we will offer you a full refund or a credit to rebook. We will always notify you at least 30 days in advance where possible.
help.cat4_q1: What support is available during my journey?
help.cat4_a1: Our 24/7 emergency line is printed on every booking confirmation. Your local guide also has a direct line to our operations team. We monitor all active trips in real time.
help.cat4_a2: Two weeks before departure you'll receive a destination-specific packing guide by email, covering clothing layers, footwear, medications, and gear recommendations.
help.cat4_a3: Travel insurance is not included in the tour price but is strongly recommended. We partner with several insurers and can point you in the right direction  visit our Travel Insurance page for more.
help.need_help_desc: Our team responds within 2 hours during business hours (Mon–Sat, 8am–8pm EAT).

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.s1_p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to remember information about your visit  such as your preferred language, login status, or items in a search  making your next visit easier and more useful.
cookies.s1_p2: Cookies cannot run programs or deliver viruses to your device. Each cookie is unique to your web browser and device.
cookies.s2_intro: We use four categories of cookies on gokusafiri.com:
cookies.type1_purpose: These cookies are required for the website to function. They include session management, authentication, CSRF protection, and language preferences.
cookies.type2_purpose: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website  which pages are most visited, how long visitors stay, and where they come from. Data is aggregated and anonymised.
cookies.type3_purpose: These cookies remember your preferences  such as your chosen currency, saved searches, or whether you've dismissed a notification  to improve your experience on return visits.
cookies.type4_purpose: These cookies are used to deliver relevant advertisements and measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns. They may be set by us or by third-party advertising partners.
cookies.s3_intro: Some cookies are set by third-party services that appear on our pages. These include:
cookies.s3_i2_desc: Fraud detection and secure payment processing during checkout.
cookies.s3_outro: Third-party cookies are governed by those companies' own privacy policies. We recommend reviewing them if you have concerns.
cookies.s4_intro: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to:
cookies.s4_i1: See what cookies are set and delete them individually.
cookies.s4_i2: Block all cookies from specific websites.
cookies.s4_i4: Clear all cookies when you close the browser.
cookies.s4_p2: Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website  in particular, you may not be able to log in or complete a booking.
cookies.s4_p3: You can also opt out of Google Analytics tracking by installing the
cookies.s5_p1: When you first visit gokusafiri.com, we ask for your consent to set optional cookies. You can update your preferences at any time by clicking the cookie settings link in the footer.
cookies.s5_p2: Strictly necessary cookies do not require consent and are set automatically to keep the website functioning.
cookies.s6_body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the cookies we use or applicable legislation. The current version is always available at gokusafiri.com/cookies.
cancel_policy.title: Cancellation policy
cancel_policy.s1_p1: Gokusafiri is committed to offering fair, transparent cancellation terms. We understand that plans change, and we aim to give you as much flexibility as possible while also protecting the local guides, lodge partners, and communities who depend on confirmed bookings.
cancel_policy.s1_p2: All cancellations must be submitted in writing to cancel@gokusafiri.com. The cancellation date is the date on which we receive and acknowledge your written request. Verbal cancellations are not accepted.
cancel_policy.s2_intro: Refund amounts are calculated as a percentage of the total booking value, based on how far in advance of departure you cancel.
cancel_policy.tier2_note: Non-refundable. We strongly recommend travel insurance.
cancel_policy.s3_step1: Email cancel@gokusafiri.com with your booking reference number and the word "Cancellation" in the subject line.
cancel_policy.s3_step2: Our team will confirm receipt within 4 business hours and calculate your refund entitlement based on the date your email is received.
cancel_policy.s3_step3: You will receive a written confirmation of your cancellation and the refund amount by email.
cancel_policy.s4_p1: Approved refunds are processed within 7–10 business days to the original payment method. Depending on your bank or card issuer, the funds may take an additional 3–5 business days to appear in your account.
cancel_policy.s4_p2: Refunds are issued in USD to the card used at the time of booking. Gokusafiri is not responsible for exchange rate fluctuations between the booking date and the refund date.
cancel_policy.s5_p1: If you wish to change your departure date rather than cancel, changes requested 14 or more days before departure are free of charge (subject to availability). A $50 administration fee applies for date changes within 14 days of departure.
cancel_policy.s5_p2: Bookings may not be transferred to another person without prior written consent from Gokusafiri.
cancel_policy.s6_body: In the event of cancellation due to extraordinary circumstances beyond either party's control (including but not limited to: natural disasters, armed conflict, government travel bans, or pandemic-related restrictions), Gokusafiri will offer a full credit voucher valid for 24 months, or a refund minus any non-recoverable costs already incurred with lodge and transport partners.
cancel_policy.s7_body: We strongly recommend purchasing comprehensive travel insurance that covers trip cancellation, medical evacuation, and interruption. Many cancellation fees can be recovered through a good travel insurance policy.
